problem:
The **exact** value of $c$ such that the average value of $f(x)=12{x}^{2}-24x+1$ on the interval $[0,c]$ is equal to $-8$ is

$c=$
{{field-1}}.

feedback.worked_solution:
To solve for $c,$ we apply the average value formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{h}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{b-a}\,{\int }_{a}^{b}h(x)\,\text{d}x \\ 6 & =\frac{1}{c-0}\,{\int }_{0}^{c}(10x-4)\,\text{d}x \\ 6 & =\frac{1}{c}(5{x}^{2}-4x){|}_{0}^{c} \\ 6 & =\frac{1}{c}[(5{c}^{2}-4c)-0] \\ 6 & =5c-4 \\ 10 & =5c \\ c & =2\end{aligned}
$$
